g.text: ⚡ THE CARTOON GUIDE TO GOOGLE OAuth2 + JWT COOKIES 🍪
From Clicking "Continue with Google" to Sealed HttpOnly JWT Cookie
🧑 Story: The shopper wants to log in. Instead of typing a password, they smash the friendly Google button!
Spring Gatekeeper sends Browser to Google (HTTP 302)
🛡️ Story: Spring Security intercepts the call: "Wait! Go prove your identity at Google first! Take my client_id with you!"
Filter: OAuth2AuthorizationRequestRedirectFilter ➜ HTTP 302 Redirect to accounts.google.com with client_id, scope=openid profile email
Google verifies user & hands back a Golden Ticket (Code)
🔍 Story: Google checks credentials/2FA and user consents. Google gives browser a temporary code & redirects to backend!
Backchannel Secret Trade: Code ➜ Google ID Token
🤝 Story: Behind the scenes (Server-to-Server), Spring trades the code + GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET for Google's signed ID Token.
Filter: OAuth2LoginAuthenticationFilter ➜ POST to https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token ➜ Returns OidcUser (sub, email)
Verify Email & Find or Create User in MySQL
🗄️ Story: Inspector verifies `email_verified == true`. Looks up MySQL: "Have we seen this Google sub ID? No? Create new User!"
Success Handler Mints ElectroMart JWT Token
💎 Story: Google's job is DONE. ElectroMart mints its OWN local VIP token with local User ID, email, ROLE_USER, signed with HMAC-SHA256!
Mint: JwtService.generateToken(user) ➜ Claims: sub=user.id, email, role=ROLE_USER, exp=1 hour, secret=JWT_SECRET
Lock JWT in HttpOnly Cookie & Redirect to React
🍪 Story: The JWT goes into a hardened cookie jar. JavaScript CANNOT read it (immune to XSS). Browser heads to /products!
Cookie: AuthCookies.issue(token, 1h, secure) ➜ Set-Cookie: ELECTROMART_JWT; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/
Storefront Doors Open! Automatic JWT Validation on APIs
🎉 Story: React loads ProductsPage. Browser silently carries the cookie on all API calls. The Filter inspects the seal instantly!
Zero risk of XSS token theft!
Spring keeps NO session in RAM.
without database hits on every request!
